sourceEvidence.text: Benefit came through Anglo-French benfet, related to Old French bienfait, from Latin benefactum, a beneficial deed. The Latin formation joins bene, well, with facere, do. This history connects doing good with an advantage received; the English verb developed from the noun. The final English letters fit are not the separate verb fit in this origin.
